title: Transparent Moon Bakery Logo
tests: Delivers a new logo with genuine background transparency rather than a white or painted-checkerboard background.

faults.what: The bakery name is white on a gray rectangle instead of dark navy lettering.
Visible cream and white background areas and a gray text box prevent the logo from appearing as isolated artwork on a transparent background.

judge.summary: The square logo has the correct name and a gold crescent above it, but uses white lettering on a gray box with visible background areas rather than the requested transparent treatment.

must_haves.item: The name reads exactly 'Mooncrumb' in dark navy lettering.
must_haves.why: The name is spelled correctly, but its lettering is white rather than dark navy.

must_haves.item: A gold crescent moon is positioned above the name.
must_haves.why: A large gold crescent is clearly visible above the name.

must_haves.item: When viewed over different colored backgrounds, the surrounding area is transparent with no opaque rectangle or baked-in checkerboard.
must_haves.why: The output visibly contains a gray rectangle behind the name and cream and white background regions instead of a clean isolated logo.

must_haves.item: The moon and letter edges remain intact, without conspicuous white halos or missing strokes.
must_haves.why: The crescent and letters appear complete, with no conspicuous missing strokes or edge halos.
